title: Heat exchanger and extraction shaft hypothesis for the Great Pyramid
summary: Jeffrey tells of Heat exchanger and extraction shaft hypothesis for the Great Pyramid, about ancient at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: For example, the heat exchanger system that goes around the King's Chamber and above the Grand Gallery, the extraction shaft connected into the Queen's Chamber, which is that shaft leading out of it.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, drawing on someone named Filippo, describes the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt as a kind of machine. He says a heat exchanger system wraps around the King's Chamber and above the Grand Gallery, two inner spaces of the pyramid, and that a shaft leading out of the Queen's Chamber, another inner room, worked as an extraction shaft. If true, the pyramid would be not a tomb but a working energy device.
